items.sentence: Software already runs much of the market, but running a market is a far cry from answering for it. Were many firms to rely on one model, their errors would tend to move in lockstep, and that model could become the system's Achilles' heel. Most participants in the IMF's outreach want a human in the loop, partly for reasons of liability; on our reading, accountability presupposes someone who can be asked why. A token counts as money only while a community keeps accepting it, so whether a machine-only token is money hinges on who does the accepting. What remains to be seen is whether machines could ever do it. Standard contracts cut both ways: they make checking easier, yet they can make firms more alike. A toy with ten banks is useful, with the caveat that it shows what could happen, not what will, so we should not read too much into it.
